description: Answers "how much should I convert to Roth each year to keep my RMDs down" for a subscriber: a year-by-year Roth conversion path from the latest tax year toward a goal (the first RMD at or under an amount, or the traditional balance at an age at or under an amount), either the smallest constant annual conversion that meets it or converting up to a chosen line each year. Each year shows the conversion, RMD, balances and the cost of converting (income tax, IRMAA surcharge two years later, and with a marketplace benchmark the ACA credit given up). Tables are held at the latest published year, amounts in today’s dollars; the real return is the user’s assumption. Read-only.

acaBenchmarkMonthly.description: Benchmark (second-lowest-cost silver) premium a month for everyone on the plan in 2026, US dollars.

acaHouseholdSize.description: Marketplace (ACA) coverage before Medicare: tax household size. With acaBenchmarkMonthly, the premium tax credit a conversion gives up is counted.

convertFrom.description: Whose traditional account the conversions come from. Default you.

filingStatus.description: Federal filing status: single, or mfj (married filing jointly).

fillToLine.description: Convert each year up to this line instead of the same amount every year. Leave out for the smallest constant annual conversion that meets the target.

maxBalance.description: Largest acceptable traditional balance at targetAge, in today’s dollars (target balance-at-age), US dollars.

maxRmd.description: Largest acceptable first RMD, in today’s dollars (target rmd-at-start-age), US dollars.

moveToState.description: A move to another state, resident there from moveFromYear on.

nonQualifiedDividends.description: Non-qualified dividends, every year, US dollars a year. Default 0.

otherOrdinary.description: Other ordinary income, every year, US dollars a year. Default 0.

pensions.description: Your pensions and annuities, today's dollars, US dollars a year. Default 0.

pensionsStartYear.description: First tax year your pension is received. Default: already received in 2026.

qualifiedDividends.description: Qualified dividends, every year, US dollars a year. Default 0.

realReturn.description: Real (after-inflation) annual return on the traditional and Roth balances, as a decimal: 0.03 is 3%. The user's assumption; ask for it.

socialSecurity.description: Your Social Security benefit, today's dollars, US dollars a year. Default 0.

socialSecurityCutPercent.description: Stress scenario the user sets, not a forecast: Social Security pays this percent less from socialSecurityCutFromYear on.

socialSecurityStartYear.description: First tax year your Social Security is received. Default: already received in 2026.

spouseBirthYear.description: Spouse's birth year; required when filing jointly.

spousePensions.description: Spouse's pensions and annuities, today's dollars, US dollars a year. Default 0.

spousePensionsStartYear.description: First tax year the spouse's pension is received. Default: already received in 2026.

spouseSocialSecurity.description: Spouse's Social Security benefit, today's dollars, US dollars a year. Default 0.

spouseSocialSecurityStartYear.description: First tax year the spouse's Social Security is received. Default: already received in 2026.

spouseTraditionalPriorYearEnd.description: Spouse's traditional balance on December 31, 2025 (joint filers), US dollars.

state.description: State of residence, two-letter code. Leave out for federal figures only.

target.description: The goal: rmd-at-start-age = keep the first required minimum distribution (the year the account owner reaches the RMD start age) at or under maxRmd; balance-at-age = bring the owner’s traditional balance at the end of the year they reach targetAge to or under maxBalance.

targetAge.description: Owner’s age for the balance target (target balance-at-age).

taxExemptInterest.description: Tax-exempt interest, every year, US dollars a year. Default 0.

taxableInterest.description: Taxable interest, every year, US dollars a year. Default 0.

traditionalPriorYearEnd.description: Your traditional IRA and 401(k) balance on December 31, 2025, from the year-end statement, US dollars.

name: roth_conversion_path

disclaimer.const: Not tax, legal or investment advice.

plannerLink.description: Opens the Dipperfield planner with these inputs filled in; the inputs travel in the link fragment, which browsers never send to a server.
